name: TofsDevOps
what: Website monitoring for people who have never heard of DNS or a 502. If your site goes down, its certificate is about to expire or search engines and AI assistants stop seeing it, the bot tells you first and explains in plain words what to do. It fixes what it can and stays quiet while all is well.
for: Owners of small sites and pet projects without a DevOps person

name: Found You
what: Before you post a photo, see what it gives away: the place, the time, your phone and the people in it. The app makes a clean copy, and the file never leaves your device.

name: Fingerprint
what: What gets learned about you while a website opens: six steps from switching on your laptop to a loaded page, on your real data and in plain words — and what to do at each step.
for: Non-technical people who want to see who learns what about them online

name: Social Tracker Bot
what: Your followers on Telegram, YouTube, Instagram and LinkedIn in one weekly report. The bot warns you at once if someone tries to take over an account or a comment appears that can get your group blocked. It stays quiet while all is well.
for: Creators and professionals growing an audience

name: morgunov.tech
what: My site: zero-build pages, an edge CMS on Cloudflare Pages, KV and R2, and the design system the other projects share.
for: People who want to know who I am or work with me

name: Lenses
what: CLI that audits a person's public digital footprint through six perception lenses.
for: People checking how they look online
